selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: The Mystic Alerts Act establishes rules to allow wireless emergency alerts to be transmitted to mobile devices via satellite in addition to traditional terrestrial mobile networks. Participating commercial mobile service providers can choose whether to transmit these satellite alerts, must follow technical regulations set by the FCC, and cannot charge extra fees for the service. Providers that opt out must notify their subscribers.

affected_groups.effect: Must file an election with the FCC, follow new technical regulations if they opt in to satellite alerts, notify subscribers if they opt out, and receive liability protections.

May receive emergency alerts via satellite on compatible devices, have the option to opt out of satellite alerts, and will be notified if their provider chooses not to offer satellite alerts without facing extra charges.
Required to issue a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking and a final rule to establish technical standards, protocols, and procedures for satellite emergency alerts.

key_provisions: Covered service providers must file an election with the FCC stating whether they intend to transmit emergency alerts by satellite.

The FCC must publish a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking within 6 months and issue a final rule within 18 months, in consultation with the Department of Homeland Security and FEMA, to establish technical requirements for satellite alerts.
If a provider chooses to transmit satellite alerts, they are prohibited from imposing a separate or additional charge for the transmission or capability.
If a provider chooses not to transmit satellite alerts, they must notify new and existing subscribers of that decision.
Subscribers using a participating provider can opt out of receiving emergency alerts via satellite.

Providers that transmit satellite alerts or elect not to transmit them are protected from certain liabilities related to the alerts or the release of subscriber information to government or public safety entities.
missing_information: Specific technical standards and protocols that the FCC will establish for satellite alert transmissions.
The exact timeline for when the Department of Homeland Security and FEMA will implement necessary standards to support alert transmissions.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Mystic Alerts Act establishes rules to allow wireless emergency alerts to be transmitted to mobile devices via satellite in addition to traditional terrestrial mobile networks. Participating commercial mobile service providers can choose whether to transmit these satellite alerts, must follow technical regulations set by the FCC, and cannot charge extra fees for the service. Providers that opt out must notify their subscribers.
summary_detail.significance: The bill introduces a framework for integrating satellite technology into the existing national wireless emergency alert system. It affects commercial mobile providers and mobile subscribers by expanding alert delivery methods while setting rules for consumer choice, provider elections, and liability.
